_comment: Every value the Guest Profile shows, and the thing that OWNS it.
CLAUDE.md rule 7: the profile gathers, it does not work things out.
The dashboard_sources.json pattern: guest_suite asserts the page
actually calls each reader, and that the patterns under `banned`
appear nowhere in it. Whichever side a change misses fails by name.
The page owns NOTHING. The one fact the mock flagged as unowned -
a past-stay count - is deliberately shown as 'Not recorded yet'
until the owner rules on recording it; when he does, its owner is

reads.value: the pre-arrival form's state, and the Stay tab's fill
reads.note: Front Desk's three states. Never recompute from `at` or the answers.

reads.value: the night's dinner answer when no /dinner cell was written
reads.note: The cell wins the moment anyone writes one; the form stands in on the arrival night only.

reads.value: the night's stays, dinner cells and prearrival records
reads.note: One reader, so this page and the boards cannot disagree about the night.
Reception's approved hour, the guest's slot, or the 2pm standing promise.
Front Desk owns the stamp; this page only reads it.

reads.value: the massage mark and the Spa tab's colour
reads.note: A suggestion outranks a booking - it is the one the desk must act on.
What a person typed wins; the name Mews sent stands behind it.

reads.value: key cards held and when they die
reads.note: The card table counted through cardRows, never worked out; the hour is CARD_CHECKOUT_HOUR.

reads.value: the nights eaten and the courses served
reads.note: Follows the BOOKING through /stays; another booking's night is not this guest's history.
The reservation's list is the person's list.
front-desk's wording, shared 12 Sep; speaks both key generations.

reads.value: how many nights the stay is
reads.note: parseDepDate under it, so a full ISO stamp and a bare date count the same.

banned.why: reading /dinner alone is the Dashboard's first-day bug; the merge lives in fetchStays + formDinnerCell
opened marks belong to fetchStays' one read
arrived is isArrived's reading, not a field to re-open
the dinner answer is formDinnerCell's merge, not the raw field
a stamp is UTC and a day is local; dkey(parseISO()) or parseDepDate, never a slice
